description: Amoxicillin is a penicillin-class antibacterial medicine used to treat certain bacterial infections.
simple_explanation: Amoxicillin is an antibiotic used to treat certain bacterial infections.
important_information: Use this medicine only as directed by a healthcare professional.
People with a history of serious allergy to penicillin or related beta-lactam antibiotics should inform their healthcare professional before use.
Do not change the prescribed dose or duration without professional advice.

description: Biotin is a B vitamin that is naturally present in some foods and is also available as a dietary supplement.
simple_explanation: Biotin is a B vitamin commonly found in foods and dietary supplements.
important_information: Biotin supplements can interfere with some laboratory tests and may cause falsely high or falsely low results.
Tell your healthcare professional about biotin or other supplements you are taking.
Use the product according to its label and seek professional advice when needed.

common_strengths: Fish oil products vary by EPA and DHA content
description: Omega-3 fatty acids are polyunsaturated fatty acids found in foods such as fish and in dietary supplements such as fish oil.
simple_explanation: Omega-3 is a group of fatty acids found in foods and supplements such as fish oil.
important_information: Fish oil is a type of dietary supplement that can provide omega-3 fatty acids.
Supplement products can differ in their EPA and DHA amounts.
Tell your healthcare professional about supplements you use, especially when taking medicines.

description: Fish oil is a dietary supplement that can provide the omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA.
simple_explanation: Fish oil is a supplement that provides omega-3 fatty acids such as EPA and DHA.
important_information: Different fish oil products can contain different amounts of EPA and DHA.
Follow the product label and do not assume that all fish oil products have the same composition.
Tell your healthcare professional about supplements you use.

description: Banaba-containing products are dietary supplements that may contain banaba leaf or banaba extract along with other ingredients.
simple_explanation: Banaba Blend appears to be a dietary supplement containing banaba and other ingredients. The exact composition depends on the product label.
important_information: Dietary supplement products can differ in their ingredients and amounts.
The presence of an ingredient on a supplement label does not establish that the product treats or prevents a disease.
People taking medicines or managing a health condition should discuss supplements with a healthcare professional.
source: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements / Dietary Supplement Label Database
